commenti.body: To me I love how self referential this movie is. I think that one of my favorite parts in the whole film was when Marcello’s character was listening to the critic he hired spout off a list of criticisms that people often leveled at Fellini. I can’t help but laugh and think about how much fun Fellini must have had making that movie. I also found it funny that a main theme of this movie was cheating (and trying to come to terms with it) and Fellini ended up cheating with one of the actresses in this film.
Haha, yes, I like very much this this personage also. That’s true. It’s said that Fellini had put a note reminding himself often that the movie should be comic
